chunks: He was seen wearing a worn-out, patched izar (lower garment).
It was pointed out to him regarding that, so he said: With it the heart becomes humble, the soul feels submissive, and the believers emulate it.
Certainly, this world and the next are two enemies, distinct from each other, and two paths that differ.
Whoever loves this world and turns his heart to it, hates the next world and is its enemy.
And they are like the East and the West. If a walker between them gets near to one, he gets farther from the other.
After all, they are like two fellow-wives.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of wearing simple clothes according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) links asceticism (zuhd) not merely to poverty but to its spiritual function in subduing the ego (nafs) and guiding the community (umma). This narration underscores the Shia concept of the world and the hereafter as mutually exclusive orientations, where love for one inherently breeds hatred for the other, a dichotomy vividly captured by the metaphor of the East and West. Such physical simplicity is thus presented as a practical discipline for cultivating inner humility and readiness for the eternal life.
